title: Add regression test for TaskSequenceGoal _isComplete fix
description: Sprint 60 Wave A added _isComplete terminal flag to TaskSequenceGoal to prevent infinite loop. No unit test verifies the scenario: TryAdvance() returns false (last step) -> IsComplete() returns true. A future refactor could silently reintroduce the infinite loop. Source: codebase-audit-20260711-10agent-swarm-5chair-council-post-wave-c.md (P3-011).
